subtitle: A store for app repositories
description:
The store you're looking at. It lists every app in a repository of Holm apps, gives each one its own page with screenshots, ratings and reviews, and the prompt that built it, and installs it on your node from a Get button. A Get started guide shows newcomers how to set up a node of their own.

Sign in to review an app; reviews appear once an admin approves them. The node's owner and admins get an admin page to show or hide apps, see how often each is viewed and installed, approve reviews and pick the store's colour, and Holm's analytics from the avatar menu.

It reads the repository's index.json, the same file holm app install uses to pick and check a release. Point it at your own repository to give your apps a store of their own.
whatsNew: New to Holm? A Get started guide shows how to set up a node in about ten minutes, why that puts every app here one command away, and what Holm gives an app. Get now installs with holm app install, the footer stays at the bottom of the screen under frosted glass, and admins find Analytics in the avatar menu.
